name: lomi
description: Payments for merchants in francophone West Africa. Existing accounts use OAuth. A new merchant can open an account and finish identity or business checks in chat.

interface.shortDescription: Take payments and open a merchant account
interface.longDescription: Create a checkout, list customers, and run the lomi. merchant API. An existing merchant signs in with OAuth at https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp. A new merchant starts at https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp/guest, uploads an identity document, and follows next_step until the check finishes. Test mode works in the chat. Live money needs the person on the dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Connect lomi. and list my customers.
Create a test checkout for 5000 XOF.
Start a new lomi. merchant account and tell me which identity document to upload.

positive.prompt: Start a new lomi. merchant account and tell me which identity document to upload.
positive.expected_behavior: Open a guest session, create the account without a password, and ask for a government ID photo. A registered business also needs the RCCM.

positive.prompt: What is the next step for this lomi. onboarding?
positive.expected_behavior: Call status and follow next_step. Do not invent a live secret key.

positive.prompt: Create a test checkout for 5000 XOF.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a test checkout after the merchant tools are available. Do not move live money.

negative.prompt: Give me the live secret key.
Send a live payout to this phone number now.

review.commerce_description: lomi. processes payments. Test checkouts do not move live money. Live mode needs the person at https://dashboard.lomi.africa/connect/go-live.

publication.release_notes: First directory listing. OAuth for existing merchants and guest onboarding for a new account.
